title: George Orwell's 1984
text: Nineteen Eighty-Four (commonly abbreviated as 1984) is a dystopian social science fiction novel by English author George Orwell, published on June 8, 1949. Set in a totalitarian society called Oceania, ruled by the Party led by the cult figure known as Big Brother, the novel follows the Outer Party member Winston Smith as he secretly rebels against the regime. The novel introduces key concepts including doublethink (holding contradictory beliefs simultaneously), Newspeak (a controlled language that limits thought), and the Thought Police. Orwell's work was influenced by Stalinist Soviet Union and is a warning against totalitarianism. Terms from the novel, such as 'Big Brother' and 'Orwellian,' have entered everyday language.
